Position : .NET SharePoint Developer 
 Location : Little Rock AR 72203 
 Duration 8 + Months 
 
 Short Description : The Senior Developer will work within a .Net development environment with a primary focus on SharePoint and MVC applications. 
 The Senior Developer will be responsible for managing the design, development and support of complex .Net solutions for a variety of state government business needs. This position will work in a lead capacity by 
 providing design guidance and oversight, such as architecture and code review, and developing and updating coding standards. A well-qualified candidate will possess expert level development skills in both MVC and SharePoint. 
 
 Duties and Responsibilities 
 • Design, develop and maintain web based applications in both MVC and SharePoint 
 • Maintain and enhance existing code 
 • Perform and participate in design and code review 
 • Analyze business and system needs and suggest solutions that leverage SharePoint out-of-the-box functionality, as well as custom solutions where applicable. 
 • Develop and provide technical support for SharePoint web parts and workflows 
 • Identify risks and make recommendations for best practices 
 
 Qualifications 
 • Bachelor’s Degree in an IT related field 
 • At least 6+ years of solid experience in C#, VB.Net and ASP.Net 
 • At least 3+ years of SharePoint development experience 
 • Strong proficiency in MVC and design patterns 
 • Strong proficiency in MS SQL 2008 or higher 
 • Expert level experience with modern web application and architectural trends 
 • Expert knowledge of Web Services, JavaScript and AJAX technologies 
 • Excellent communications skills both written and verbal 


 
 
 Thanks and Regards, 
 Sumit Gupta 
 
 Technical Recruiter | ASK IT Consulting Inc. 
 Women Owned Minority Certified Enterprise 
 Address: # 33 Peachtree Court Holtsville, NY 11742 
 Phone: +1 631-649-1313 Ext- 4401 
 Fax: +1-631 803 4488
